blanks.noTemplates: No approved template yet. Make one in Settings, WhatsApp, and wait for WhatsApp to approve it.

settings.title: Sales automation
settings.intro: What your sales do by themselves, so no lead waits and none is forgotten. Each WhatsApp is one of your approved templates.

problems.check: Check the settings: every template needs a value for each blank, and each follow-up some days after the one before.

speed.title: Reply to new leads in a minute
speed.description: A lead from your ads, website or a sheet gets this WhatsApp within a minute, day or night. Leads who answer first convert the most.
speed.consent: People who enquire with their number agree to hear back on WhatsApp
speed.consentHint: WhatsApp needs their agreement before you message first. Turn this on if your forms and ads say you will contact them on WhatsApp. Anyone who writes STOP is never messaged.

follow.title: Follow up when they go quiet
follow.description: If the customer doesn't write back, they get a nudge on each of these days, between 10 am and 8 pm. The moment they write, the lead closes or reaches Booking requested, it stops.
follow.none: No follow-ups yet. Add Day 1, Day 3 and Day 7.
follow.day: Follow-up {number}: days after the lead came
follow.dayHint: Each comes after the one before.

reminder.title: Remind customers to pay
reminder.description: For a payment due on an accepted quote: a WhatsApp with the amount, the day and the link to pay by UPI, some days before, and once the day after if it's missed. You are told too.
reminder.template: Reminder template (when they haven't written in 24 hours)
reminder.windowHint: Inside WhatsApp's 24-hour window we send a plain message with the link; outside it, this template.

hot.title: What makes a lead hot
hot.description: Hot leads come first on Home and Today, with Call now. Opening a quote twice or asking to book also tells the salesperson at once.
hot.keywordsHint: Words in a customer's message, with commas between: price, book, advance.
hot.travelDaysHint: A trip that starts this soon is hot. 0 for never.

hot.title: {count, plural, one {# hot lead: call now} other {# hot leads: call now}}
hot.description: They are deciding. A call in the next hour wins most of them.

follow.none: No automatic follow-ups for this lead.
follow.active: Automatic follow-ups: {sent} of {steps} sent. The next goes {next}.

lost.title: Mark this lead lost?
lost.description: Its open follow-ups are cancelled. Why it was lost helps you win back such leads later.
